1. Reusable Business Objects In multi-tier data applications, business objects encapsulate your core business logic, database entities, and validation rules.
2. The Builder Pattern To maintain a clean separation between the database and the user interface, we use a "Builder" object. A builder constructs ViewModels. One builder handles a logical unit and pulls data to build a specific view.
3. Integration Approaches • Approach 1 (Direct Embedding): The view model directly references and contains the entire business object. • Approach 2 (Selective Mapping - Best Practice): The builder extracts ONLY the specific data fields required by the user interface.
